verdict.rationale: Mercury documents sending money abroad through international wire and no-fee USD payments around the globe, so the cross-border half of the story is covered. Nothing in the evidence addresses settlement speed, and there is no claim or hands-on report that funds arrive in under a minute. Missing for 10: any documented or corroborated sub-minute international arrival time, real-time cross-border rails or speed SLA, and independent or hands-on confirmation of transfer speed.

support.subject: As a founder, I can send money abroad that arrives in under a minute
